pipeline_result.response: The play "Human Drama" (1964) by Anaïs Nin, written and directed by Nineteeth Nin, was produced as the Best of Human Drama at the Ring of Honor Theatre in New York City on June 19, 2015.
retrieved_context: Collages (novel): Collages, published in 1964, was Anaïs Nin's last published novel (excluding her erotica).  It is very different from the previous novels of the "Cities of the Interior" series, because it contains none of the familiar characters in those novels.  It is also different in that it takes place on two continents, has about two dozen important characters, and for the first time in Anaïs Nin's work the female lead is not seeking psychological wholeness.  Most of Anaïs Nin's other novels only have a few main characters, there is rarely much geographical movement in the other novels, and usually the lead character is a woman seeking psychological wholeness.

Best in the World '15: Best in the World '15 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Ring of Honor that took place at Terminal 5 in New York City, New York on June 19, 2015.  It was the sixth annual ROH Best in the World event, the first to take place on a Friday, and the second Best in the World event to be broadcast on traditional pay-per-view outlets.
